description: VOA S001 body says only that a demonstration had occurred in Huambo before the Jan 6 article; it gives no event date or crowd size and does not state that it was within January. Opened Imparcial Press S006 is dated Dec 14, 2024 and says protests occurred “this week,” with Huambo leading and about 300 professionals in the streets over unpaid remote-zone isolation allowances; this is an out-of-period boundary lead with no exact day or January continuity. The Jan 28 search-only Carta de Angola S007 reports allowance suspension pending investigation of possible ghost employees but does not describe a public gathering. Benguela school absences and planned municipal protests remain work stoppage/announcement leads, not confirmed assemblies.
required_followup: Search for an exact January dated report or primary statement tying actual assembly to the Huambo allowance grievance; verify date, threshold, state target and response. Do not equate the Jan 6 VOA lead with the December action unless direct linkage emerges. No January event coded.

description: Fifteen unique search invocations include 58 query strings relevant to January, covering Portuguese/English month-window, teachers, unions, workers, students, local province outlets and targeted Huambo isolation-allowance terms. Results were noisy and often drifted to other years. Coverage of other provinces/sectors and archives remains incomplete; absence of a search result does not establish absence of protest.
required_followup: Continue province/sector/week-window and local-language searches, and check late-Dec/early-Jan continuity. Document inaccessible archives; no LexisNexis-equivalent archive searched.
